context: A police officer briefs about an investigation
purpose: Teach: 重なり/言い回し/輪郭/際立っ/押さえる/手腕/旧式/ずさん

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、複数の事案が重なりました。
lines.en: This case involved multiple incidents that overlapped.
lines.style: Even, measured tone. Professional distance. A slight pause before speaking, gathering thoughts. Steady and deliberate—no rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者の言い回し、独特ですね。
lines.en: The suspect's choice of words was unusual, wasn't it?
lines.style: Soft, almost thinking aloud. Hesitant—testing whether he's on the right track. Genuine curiosity, not showing off. A question searching for confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。輪郭が、まだはっきりしません。
lines.en: Right. The full picture still isn't clear.
lines.style: Factual acknowledgement. A small pause between clauses—weighing what he can and cannot say. Professional restraint.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 防犯映像、被害者の様子、際立っていますね。
lines.en: The surveillance footage—the victim's condition really stands out.
lines.style: Careful observation. Lean in slightly with genuine focus. A touch of concern underneath. Not accusatory, just noticing. Soft pause before the second clause.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 押さえるべき証拠、まだ収集中です。
lines.en: The critical evidence is still being collected.
lines.style: Professional update. Even tempo. A touch of patience—this is routine work. No frustration, just matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警部の手腕、信頼されてますね。
lines.en: Your work has earned real trust, Inspector.
lines.style: Genuine respect, slightly awkward in how he delivers it. Not flattery—observation. A small smile might cross his face. Sincere but uncomfortable with compliments.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 旧式の機材も、捜査に活用。
lines.en: Even outdated equipment can be useful in the investigation.
lines.style: Modest deflection. Brief and factual—accepting the compliment by moving forward. No false modesty, just steady practicality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ずさんな管理、被疑者組織の特徴ですね。
lines.en: Sloppy management—that's a signature of the suspect organization.
lines.style: Piecing things together. Thoughtful, almost to himself. Building toward understanding. A slow breath—synthesis rather than accusation.
